A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that the strain relaxation and the strain gradients in BFO/SRO nanostructures are correlated with the ferroelectric domain pattern.
elastic strain is released from the film by the formation of ferroelectric domain structures and the release of strain is localized to regions of high domain density.
the elasticrelaxation within a nanostructure is a function of both the local film strain and the ferroelectric domain configuration.
The main takeaway from our work is that
elasticrelaxation in nanostructures is not uniform but rather is localized within domains and at domain boundaries.
